issue: राज हंस तुम्हारो शचि वाहन — शचि (Śacī, Indra's queen) makes no sense beside the swan; शुचि ('pure', 'bright') would. The book, Drik Panchang and Shubh Panchang all print शचि, so the witnesses do not settle it.
our reading: शचि (as printed): 'the royal swan is your vehicle'; the word is left as the witnesses have it.

issue: तुलसी सूर्य आदि विद्वाना: सूर्य is 'the Sun', but beside Tulasī among poets it stands for Sūradāsa (the metre needs three mātrās).
our reading: Tulasīdāsa, Sūradāsa and other learned men.
alternatives: सूर्य 'the Sun' (a god, not a learned poet).
